description: This file defines a React component plugin for the Lexical rich text editor that enforces a maximum list indentation depth. It includes utility functions to determine the selection's list nodes and whether indentation is allowed based on maxDepth. It registers a command to prevent exceeding the maxDepth when attempting to indent list items.

methods.name: getElementNodesInSelection
methods.description: Collects all ElementNode instances within the current selection, including the parent nodes if no nodes are explicitly selected.

methods.name: isIndentPermitted
methods.description: Checks if the current selection's list items can be indented further without exceeding the maximum depth.
